title: 次級離子質譜儀~Secondary-ion mass spectrometers
focus: 濺射與離子化機率、有用產率、質量解析、相對靈敏度因子與深度剖析的痕量分析工程~Sputtering and ionisation probability, useful yield, mass resolution, relative sensitivity factors and depth-profiling engineering for trace analysis
summary: 從一次離子的碰撞級聯與二次離子化機率出發，理解 SIMS 為何能偵測 ppb 等級的摻雜卻受基質效應支配，再把靜態與動態模式、一次離子源、磁扇與飛行時間質量分析、植入標準片的靈敏度因子校正、偵測極限、電荷補償與濺射坑效應整合成可驗收的深度剖析工程。~Start from the collision cascade of primary ions and the secondary ionisation probability to see why SIMS detects ppb-level dopants yet is ruled by matrix effects, then integrate static and dynamic modes, primary ion sources, magnetic-sector and time-of-flight mass analysis, sensitivity-factor calibration with implant standards, detection limits, charge compensation and crater effects into an acceptable depth-profiling record.

units.anchor: 碰撞級聯與二次離子~Collision cascade and secondary ions
units.title: 濺射、離子化機率與有用產率~Sputtering, ionisation probability and useful yield
units.mechanism: 能量 0.25 到 30 keV 的一次離子打進固體後引發碰撞級聯，把動量傳回表面，使最上面一到兩個原子層的原子被濺射出來；每個一次離子濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，典型為 1 到 10。被濺射的粒子只有一小部分帶電，離子化機率 α⁺ 或 α⁻ 從 10⁻⁵ 到 10⁻¹，而且強烈依賴表面化學：O₂⁺ 轟擊或氧氣吹掃把表面氧化，大幅提高正離子產率；Cs⁺ 降低表面功函數，提高負離子產率。這種基質效應是 SIMS 定量困難的根源，也是它靈敏度極高的來源。~Primary ions of 0.25 to 30 keV entering a solid start a collision cascade that returns momentum to the surface and sputters atoms from the top one or two atomic layers; the number of atoms sputtered per primary ion, the sputter yield Y, is typically 1 to 10. Only a small fraction of the sputtered particles are charged, with ionisation probabilities α⁺ or α⁻ from 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻¹ that depend strongly on surface chemistry: O₂⁺ bombardment or oxygen flooding oxidises the surface and greatly raises positive-ion yields, while Cs⁺ lowers the surface work function and raises negative-ion yields. This matrix effect is the root of SIMS quantification difficulty and also the source of its extreme sensitivity.
units.model: 偵測計數率 ≈ I_p·Y·c·α·T，其中 c 為原子分率、T 為儀器傳輸率。取 O₂⁺ 一次束流 1 µA（6.25×10¹² ions/s）、Y = 3、矽中硼濃度 1 ppm（c = 10⁻⁶，即 5×10¹⁶ cm⁻³）、α⁺(B) = 10⁻²、T = 0.3：計數率 ≈ 6.25×10¹²×3×10⁻⁶×10⁻²×0.3 ≈ 56 cps。有用產率 τ = α·T = 3×10⁻³，即每濺射 330 個硼原子偵測到 1 個；若改用 Ar⁺ 使 α⁺ 降到 10⁻⁴，同樣濃度只剩 0.6 cps。~The detected count rate ≈ I_p·Y·c·α·T, with c the atomic fraction and T the instrument transmission. With a 1 µA O₂⁺ primary beam (6.25×10¹² ions/s), Y = 3, boron in silicon at 1 ppm (c = 10⁻⁶, about 5×10¹⁶ cm⁻³), α⁺(B) = 10⁻² and T = 0.3: count rate ≈ 6.25×10¹²×3×10⁻⁶×10⁻²×0.3 ≈ 56 cps. The useful yield τ = α·T = 3×10⁻³ means one detected ion per 330 sputtered boron atoms; switching to Ar⁺ with α⁺ down to 10⁻⁴ leaves only 0.6 cps at the same concentration.
units.verify: 在同一片矽上分別用 O₂⁺ 與 Ar⁺ 轟擊並量 Si⁺ 與 B⁺ 的計數率，比值應顯示 O₂⁺ 的增強效果達 1 到 2 個數量級；再用氧氣吹掃改變表面氧覆蓋，觀察正離子產率隨氧分壓上升到飽和。濺射產率可由法拉第杯量一次束流、輪廓儀量坑體積與時間求得。~Bombard one silicon wafer alternately with O₂⁺ and Ar⁺ and measure Si⁺ and B⁺ count rates; the ratio should show an O₂⁺ enhancement of one to two orders of magnitude; then vary surface oxygen coverage with oxygen flooding and watch positive-ion yields rise to saturation with oxygen pressure. Obtain the sputter yield from the primary current in a Faraday cup, the crater volume from a profilometer and the elapsed time.
units.failure: 在氧化層與矽的界面，氧覆蓋突然改變使 α⁺ 跳變數倍，深度剖析在界面出現假的濃度峰或谷；若不認識這個基質效應，會把儀器假象報告為界面偏析。~At an oxide–silicon interface the sudden change in oxygen coverage jumps α⁺ by several times, so depth profiles show a false concentration peak or dip at the interface; without recognising the matrix effect this artefact is reported as interfacial segregation.
units.misconception: 二次離子強度只和元素濃度成正比，與周圍材料無關。~Secondary-ion intensity depends only on element concentration, not on the surrounding material.

units.anchor: 一次離子劑量與靜態極限~Primary-ion dose and the static limit
units.title: 靜態與動態 SIMS 的劑量邊界~Dose boundaries of static and dynamic SIMS
units.mechanism: 靜態 SIMS 把一次離子總劑量限制在約 10¹² 到 10¹³ ions/cm²，遠低於表面一個單層的 10¹⁵ atoms/cm²，使大多數分析區域在被量到時仍未被先前的離子損傷，因此能保留分子碎片與完整分子離子的資訊，適合有機表面與單層分析。動態 SIMS 刻意用高劑量連續濺射，以每秒零點幾奈米的速率剝除材料並持續記錄各質量的強度，把時間軸換算成深度軸，用於半導體摻雜分佈與多層膜的深度剖析。~Static SIMS limits the total primary-ion dose to roughly 10¹² to 10¹³ ions/cm², far below the 10¹⁵ atoms/cm² of a surface monolayer, so most of the analysed area is still undamaged by earlier ions when it is sampled; molecular fragments and intact molecular ions survive, which suits organic surfaces and monolayers. Dynamic SIMS deliberately sputters continuously at high dose, removing material at a fraction of a nanometre per second while recording the intensity of each mass, converting the time axis into depth for semiconductor dopant distributions and multilayer profiles.
units.model: 每個一次離子的損傷截面取 σ = 10 nm² = 10⁻¹³ cm²，表面未受損的比例為 exp(−σ·D)：劑量 D = 10¹² ions/cm² 時為 exp(−0.1) ≈ 90%，10¹³ 時降為 37%，10¹⁴ 時只剩 0.005%，所以靜態極限取 10¹² 等級。動態模式濺射速率：Cs⁺ 1 keV、50 nA 掃描 200 µm × 200 µm，電流密度 1.25×10⁻⁴ A/cm² 即 7.8×10¹⁴ ions/(cm²·s)，Y = 2、矽原子密度 5×10²² cm⁻³，速率 ≈ 7.8×10¹⁴×2/5×10²² = 3.1×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.31 nm/s，1 µm 的剖析需約 54 分鐘。~Taking a damage cross-section σ = 10 nm² = 10⁻¹³ cm² per primary ion, the undamaged fraction of the surface is exp(−σ·D): at a dose D = 10¹² ions/cm² it is exp(−0.1) ≈ 90%, at 10¹³ it drops to 37% and at 10¹⁴ only 0.005% remains, which is why the static limit is set near 10¹². Dynamic sputter rate: 1 keV Cs⁺ at 50 nA rastered over 200 µm × 200 µm gives 1.25×10⁻⁴ A/cm², or 7.8×10¹⁴ ions/(cm²·s); with Y = 2 and a silicon atomic density of 5×10²² cm⁻³ the rate is ≈ 7.8×10¹⁴×2/5×10²² = 3.1×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.31 nm/s, so a 1 µm profile takes about 54 minutes.
units.verify: 靜態模式下在一片自組裝單層上以遞增劑量重複取譜，把分子離子強度對劑量作圖，擬合指數衰減得到 σ，確認所用的分析劑量讓衰減小於 10%；動態模式下以輪廓儀量濺射坑深度並除以濺射時間，得到實際速率並與電流密度估計比較。~In static mode take repeated spectra on a self-assembled monolayer at increasing dose, plot the molecular-ion intensity against dose and fit an exponential decay to extract σ, confirming that the analysis dose keeps the decay below 10%; in dynamic mode measure the crater depth with a profilometer, divide by sputter time to get the real rate and compare with the current-density estimate.
units.failure: 用動態模式的劑量去量有機薄膜，分子離子在第一個像素就被打碎，譜圖只剩 C⁺、CH⁺ 等小碎片，被誤讀為樣品沒有完整分子；反之用靜態劑量做深度剖析，則永遠到不了下層。~Running an organic film at dynamic-mode dose destroys the molecular ions in the first pixel and leaves only small fragments such as C⁺ and CH⁺, misread as absence of intact molecules; conversely a depth profile at static dose never reaches the layer below.
units.misconception: 一次離子劑量越大訊號越強，所以劑量總是越高越好。~More primary-ion dose always means more signal, so dose should always be maximised.

units.anchor: O₂⁺/Cs⁺ 離子槍與 Bi 液態金屬離子源~O₂⁺/Cs⁺ guns and Bi liquid-metal ion source
units.title: 一次離子源與離子柱設計~Primary ion sources and ion-column design
units.mechanism: 動態 SIMS 常用雙電漿管產生 O₂⁺、表面離子化源產生 Cs⁺，束流從 nA 到 µA、束徑數微米到數十微米，追求高濺射速率與穩定電流。靜態與影像 TOF-SIMS 用液態金屬離子源產生 Bi⁺、Bi₃⁺ 等團簇，亮度高到能聚焦到 50 nm 以下，而團簇離子把能量分散在表面淺層，二次離子產率比單原子離子高一個數量級。氣體團簇離子源（Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ 到 Ar₅₀₀₀⁺）每個原子只帶幾 eV，低於原子位移閾值，能剖析有機多層而不累積化學損傷。離子柱包含質量過濾、靜電透鏡、偏轉與掃描板，並配備法拉第杯量束流。~Dynamic SIMS commonly uses a duoplasmatron for O₂⁺ and a surface-ionisation source for Cs⁺, with beams from nanoamperes to microamperes and diameters from a few to tens of micrometres, aiming at high sputter rate and stable current. Static and imaging TOF-SIMS use liquid-metal ion sources producing Bi⁺ and Bi₃⁺ clusters bright enough to focus below 50 nm, and cluster ions deposit their energy in a shallow layer so secondary-ion yields exceed those of monatomic ions by an order of magnitude. Gas-cluster sources (Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ to Ar₅₀₀₀⁺) carry only a few electronvolts per atom, below the atomic displacement threshold, and profile organic multilayers without accumulating chemical damage. The column holds a mass filter, electrostatic lenses, deflection and raster plates, and a Faraday cup for current measurement.
units.model: 能量分配：Bi₃⁺ 加速 30 keV 時每個 Bi 原子帶 10 keV，仍會造成深層損傷但有機二次離子產率約為 Bi⁺ 的 10 倍；Ar₂₀₀₀⁺ 加速 10 keV 時每個原子僅 5 eV，低於約 25 eV 的位移閾值，剖析聚合物時特徵分子離子強度可維持在初值的 80% 以上。束流與束徑的取捨：液態金屬源亮度約 10⁶ A/(cm²·sr)，在 50 nm 束徑下電流只有約 0.1 pA，要累積 10⁶ 個計數的影像需要數十分鐘。~Energy partition: Bi₃⁺ accelerated to 30 keV carries 10 keV per Bi atom, still damaging the subsurface but giving organic secondary-ion yields about 10 times those of Bi⁺; Ar₂₀₀₀⁺ at 10 keV carries only 5 eV per atom, below the roughly 25 eV displacement threshold, so characteristic molecular ions of a polymer stay above 80% of their initial intensity through a profile. Current versus spot: a liquid-metal source with brightness near 10⁶ A/(cm²·sr) delivers only about 0.1 pA into a 50 nm spot, so an image accumulating 10⁶ counts needs tens of minutes.
units.verify: 以法拉第杯量各離子種的束流並記錄穩定度（1 小時內變化 < 2%）；用刀口或細網格掃描量束徑（16% 到 84% 寬度）；在同一聚合物上比較 Bi⁺、Bi₃⁺ 與 Ar 團簇的特徵離子產率與損傷截面，確認團簇的產率增益與低損傷特性與公開文獻量級一致。~Measure each ion species' current in a Faraday cup and log its stability (under 2% change in an hour); determine spot size by a knife-edge or fine-grid scan (16% to 84% width); on one polymer compare characteristic-ion yields and damage cross-sections for Bi⁺, Bi₃⁺ and Ar clusters, confirming that the cluster yield gain and low damage agree in magnitude with the public literature.
units.failure: 液態金屬源的 Bi 尖端在真空不良時氧化，發射電流抖動並在影像上留下橫向條紋；Cs⁺ 源的鉻酸銫燒盡後電流緩慢衰減，深度剖析的時間深度換算被拉長，若未以坑深校正，深度尺度會系統性偏淺。~A Bi liquid-metal tip oxidises in poor vacuum, its emission current flickers and horizontal stripes appear in images; a Cs⁺ source whose caesium chromate is exhausted loses current slowly, stretching the time-to-depth conversion of profiles, and without crater-depth correction the depth scale becomes systematically too shallow.
units.misconception: 一次離子能量越高，二次離子產率一定越高、深度解析度也越好。~Higher primary-ion energy always gives higher secondary-ion yield and better depth resolution.

units.anchor: 磁扇與飛行時間質量分析器~Magnetic-sector and time-of-flight analysers
units.title: 質量分析器與質量干擾分離~Mass analysers and separating mass interferences
units.mechanism: 二次離子被數 kV 的萃取電場收集後送入質量分析器。雙聚焦磁扇儀器（靜電扇加磁扇）在高傳輸率下提供 m/Δm 數千到上萬的解析度，可連續監測少數幾個質量，是動態深度剖析的主力；飛行時間分析器在一次脈衝內記錄全部質量，搭配反射鏡可達 m/Δm 30 000 以上，適合靜態與影像分析；四極桿簡單便宜但解析度只到單位質量。質量解析度的實際意義在分離同標稱質量的干擾，例如 ³¹P⁺ 與 ³⁰Si¹H⁺、⁵⁶Fe⁺ 與 ²⁸Si₂⁺，而干擾的強度往往比痕量元素高幾個數量級。~Secondary ions collected by a several-kilovolt extraction field enter the mass analyser. Double-focusing magnetic-sector instruments (electrostatic plus magnetic sectors) provide m/Δm of thousands to tens of thousands at high transmission and monitor a few masses continuously, the workhorse for dynamic depth profiling; time-of-flight analysers record all masses from each pulse and with a reflectron exceed m/Δm of 30 000, suiting static and imaging work; quadrupoles are simple and cheap but reach only unit mass resolution. Mass resolution matters for separating isobaric interferences such as ³¹P⁺ from ³⁰Si¹H⁺ or ⁵⁶Fe⁺ from ²⁸Si₂⁺, where the interference is often orders of magnitude stronger than the trace element.
units.model: ³¹P 質量 30.9738 u，³⁰Si¹H 為 29.9738 + 1.0078 = 30.9816 u，Δm = 0.0078 u，所需 m/Δm = 30.97/0.0078 ≈ 3 970；⁵⁶Fe 55.9349 u 對 ²⁸Si₂ 55.9539 u，Δm = 0.0190 u，需 m/Δm ≈ 2 940。磁扇儀器把解析度從 300 提高到 4 000 時，狹縫縮小使傳輸率降到約 1/10，磷的計數率同步下降，但 ³⁰SiH⁺ 干擾被壓低 3 個數量級以上，淨效果是偵測極限改善 100 倍。~³¹P has mass 30.9738 u while ³⁰Si¹H is 29.9738 + 1.0078 = 30.9816 u, Δm = 0.0078 u, requiring m/Δm = 30.97/0.0078 ≈ 3 970; ⁵⁶Fe at 55.9349 u against ²⁸Si₂ at 55.9539 u, Δm = 0.0190 u, needs m/Δm ≈ 2 940. Raising a magnetic-sector instrument from resolution 300 to 4 000 narrows the slits and cuts transmission to about one tenth, lowering the phosphorus count rate accordingly, yet the ³⁰SiH⁺ interference is suppressed by more than three orders of magnitude, so the net detection limit improves about 100-fold.
units.verify: 在矽中磷植入標準片上掃描 m/z = 31 附近的高解析質譜，確認 ³¹P⁺ 與 ³⁰SiH⁺ 在設定解析度下分離達 10% 谷值；記錄不同狹縫設定下的傳輸率曲線；TOF 儀器則以已知的分子離子對（如 C₂H₄⁺ 與 CO⁺、N₂⁺，m/z 28）量 m/Δm 並確認質量精度在 ±5 ppm 內。~On a phosphorus-implanted silicon standard scan a high-resolution mass spectrum around m/z = 31 and confirm that ³¹P⁺ and ³⁰SiH⁺ separate to a 10% valley at the set resolution; record the transmission curve for each slit setting; on a TOF instrument measure m/Δm with known molecular-ion pairs such as C₂H₄⁺, CO⁺ and N₂⁺ at m/z 28 and confirm mass accuracy within ±5 ppm.
units.failure: 以單位質量解析度量矽中的磷，³⁰SiH⁺ 的訊號被當成磷，報告出 10¹⁸ cm⁻³ 等級的假磷濃度，而且深度剖析隨氫背景起伏而非真實分佈；高解析模式下若磁場漂移 0.01% 未鎖定，峰頂滑出狹縫，計數率忽高忽低像是樣品不均勻。~Measuring phosphorus in silicon at unit mass resolution counts ³⁰SiH⁺ as phosphorus, reporting a false concentration near 10¹⁸ cm⁻³ whose profile follows the hydrogen background rather than any real distribution; in high-resolution mode an unlocked magnetic field drifting by 0.01% slides the peak top off the slit and the count rate wanders as if the sample were inhomogeneous.
units.misconception: 只要質量數不同就能分開，解析度只是錦上添花。~Different nominal masses are always separable; resolution is merely a bonus.

units.anchor: 離子植入標準片與 RSF~Ion-implanted standard and RSF
units.title: 相對靈敏度因子與深度尺度校正~Relative sensitivity factors and depth-scale calibration
units.mechanism: 因為基質效應，SIMS 定量必須靠與未知樣品相同基質的標準片：把已知劑量的元素離子植入矽、鍺或 GaAs，以相同條件剖析，積分訊號對深度即可得到相對靈敏度因子 RSF，定義為濃度 = RSF × (痕量離子強度/基質離子強度)。深度尺度來自濺射坑深度與時間的線性換算，坑深以觸針輪廓儀或干涉儀量測；當剖析跨越不同材料層時，各層的濺射速率不同，必須分段校正。RSF 隨一次離子種類、能量、入射角與氧氣吹掃條件改變，所以標準片必須在同一個分析配方下量測。~Because of the matrix effect, SIMS quantification relies on standards with the same matrix as the unknown: a known dose of the element is ion-implanted into silicon, germanium or GaAs and profiled under identical conditions, and integrating the signal over depth yields the relative sensitivity factor RSF, defined by concentration = RSF × (trace-ion intensity/matrix-ion intensity). The depth scale comes from a linear conversion of crater depth and time, with the crater depth measured by a stylus profilometer or interferometer; when a profile crosses different material layers each has its own sputter rate and must be calibrated separately. RSF changes with primary-ion species, energy, incidence angle and oxygen flooding, so the standard must be measured under the same analytical recipe.
units.model: 硼植入矽標準片劑量 Φ = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻²，剖析到坑深 600 nm 共 1 200 s（0.5 nm/s）。把每個資料點的 I_B/I_Si 乘上深度步長後加總得 Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm，則 RSF = Φ/Σ = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³。未知晶圓在同配方下量得 I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴，濃度 = 5×10²¹×10⁻⁴ = 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³，約 10 ppm 原子分率。坑深量測不確定 ±10 nm 對 600 nm 的深度尺度貢獻 ±1.7%。~A boron-implanted silicon standard with dose Φ = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² is profiled to a 600 nm crater in 1 200 s (0.5 nm/s). Multiplying each point's I_B/I_Si by the depth step and summing gives Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm, so RSF = Φ/Σ = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³. An unknown wafer under the same recipe shows I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴, hence a concentration of 5×10²¹×10⁻⁴ = 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³, about 10 ppm atomic. A ±10 nm crater-depth uncertainty contributes ±1.7% to the 600 nm depth scale.
units.verify: 每個分析配方都用對應的植入標準片量 RSF，五次重複的相對標準差應小於 10%；劑量以經認證的植入片或 RBS 交叉驗證；坑深在坑底至少三個位置量測並取平均，坑底平整度應優於深度的 2%；剖析形狀與 TRIM/SRIM 模擬的植入分佈峰位比較，確認深度尺度無系統偏差。~Measure the RSF with the matching implant standard for every analytical recipe, requiring a relative standard deviation below 10% over five repeats; cross-validate the dose with a certified implant or RBS; measure the crater depth at three or more floor positions and average, with floor flatness better than 2% of depth; compare the profile shape with the TRIM/SRIM-simulated implant peak position to confirm the depth scale has no systematic bias.
units.failure: 把矽基質的 RSF 套用到 SiGe 或 GaAs，濃度誤差可達數倍；深度剖析跨越氧化層時若沿用矽的濺射速率，氧化層被錯算得太厚或太薄，摻雜峰位置全部錯置。~Applying a silicon-matrix RSF to SiGe or GaAs produces concentration errors of several times; carrying the silicon sputter rate through an oxide layer misplaces the oxide thickness and shifts every dopant peak position.
units.misconception: RSF 是元素的常數，一次量好可用在任何樣品與儀器條件。~An RSF is a constant of the element, usable on any sample and instrument condition once measured.

units.anchor: 電子倍增器計數與背景~Electron-multiplier counting and background
units.title: 計數統計、背景與偵測極限~Counting statistics, background and detection limits
units.mechanism: 二次離子以電子倍增器脈衝計數偵測，強訊號改用法拉第杯以避免飽和，兩者在重疊區交叉校正，動態範圍可達 8 到 9 個數量級。偵測極限由背景決定：殘氣吸附的 H、C、O，離子柱與腔壁的記憶效應，質量干擾的拖尾，以及倍增器的暗計數。痕量元素的計數遵循 Poisson 統計，訊號必須高於背景的 3σ；延長每個資料點的停留時間或增加一次束流都能改善，但束流增加同時加快濺射，深度解析度與總分析時間隨之改變。~Secondary ions are detected by pulse counting on an electron multiplier, with a Faraday cup taking over for strong signals to avoid saturation and the two cross-calibrated in their overlap, giving a dynamic range of 8 to 9 orders of magnitude. The detection limit is set by background: H, C and O adsorbed from residual gas, memory effects from the ion column and chamber walls, tails of mass interferences and the multiplier's dark counts. Trace counts follow Poisson statistics and the signal must exceed 3σ of the background; longer dwell per data point or higher primary current helps, but higher current also sputters faster, changing depth resolution and total analysis time.
units.model: 沿用 1 ppm 硼給 56 cps 的條件（即 5×10¹⁶ cm⁻³ 對應 56 cps），背景 0.5 cps、停留時間 1 s：偵測極限 ≈ 3√(0.5×1)/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³；停留時間延長到 10 s，背景計數 5、3√5 = 6.7 對訊號 560，偵測極限降到 0.012 ppm ≈ 6×10¹⁴ cm⁻³。倍增器死時間 50 ns 時，10⁶ cps 的計數損失約 5%，必須修正後才能與法拉第杯的 10⁷ cps 接軌。~Using the earlier condition of 56 cps per ppm of boron (5×10¹⁶ cm⁻³ gives 56 cps) with a background of 0.5 cps and 1 s dwell: detection limit ≈ 3√(0.5×1)/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³; extending the dwell to 10 s gives 5 background counts, 3√5 = 6.7 against a 560-count signal, and the limit falls to 0.012 ppm ≈ 6×10¹⁴ cm⁻³. With a 50 ns multiplier dead time, counting at 10⁶ cps loses about 5% and must be corrected before matching the Faraday cup at 10⁷ cps.
units.verify: 在高純度浮區矽上以分析配方剖析，記錄 B、P、C、O、H 的背景計數率並換算為等效濃度，作為該配方的偵測極限；以已知濃度的植入片在倍增器與法拉第杯重疊區（約 10⁵ 到 10⁶ cps）取數據，擬合死時間並確認兩偵測器讀值一致在 ±5% 內。~Profile high-purity float-zone silicon with the analytical recipe, log background count rates for B, P, C, O and H and convert them to equivalent concentrations as the recipe's detection limits; on an implant of known concentration collect data in the multiplier–Faraday overlap (about 10⁵ to 10⁶ cps), fit the dead time and confirm the two detectors agree within ±5%.
units.failure: 分析腔真空從 10⁻¹⁰ 退化到 10⁻⁸ mbar，氫與碳背景上升兩個數量級，矽中碳的偵測極限從 10¹⁶ 退到 10¹⁸ cm⁻³，低濃度樣品被報告成污染；倍增器老化增益下降而未重設閾值，計數率緩慢下滑，被誤解為 RSF 改變。~Vacuum degrading from 10⁻¹⁰ to 10⁻⁸ mbar raises hydrogen and carbon backgrounds by two orders of magnitude, pushing the carbon-in-silicon detection limit from 10¹⁶ to 10¹⁸ cm⁻³ so low-level samples are reported as contaminated; an ageing multiplier losing gain without a threshold reset lets the count rate sag slowly, misread as a change in RSF.
units.misconception: 把停留時間加倍，偵測極限就改善一倍。~Doubling the dwell time halves the detection limit.

units.anchor: 濺射坑、電子閘控與電子中和槍~Crater, electronic gating and electron flood gun
units.title: 深度解析度、坑效應與電荷補償~Depth resolution, crater effects and charge compensation
units.mechanism: 深度剖析的解析度受三個因素限制：一次離子把原子推向更深處的離子混合，深度約為投影射程的 2 倍；濺射造成的表面粗糙化；以及濺射坑壁斜面持續貢獻尚未剖析到的淺層訊號。低能量（250 eV 到 1 keV）與斜入射減少混合，旋轉樣品抑制粗糙化，電子閘控只接受來自掃描區中央一小部分的二次離子以排除坑壁。絕緣樣品在正離子轟擊下累積正電荷，二次離子能量偏移、訊號消失，必須以低能電子槍中和，負一次離子（O⁻）或 TOF 的脈衝電子中和也是常用手段。整合這些機制與腔體真空、樣品台精度，才能同時達到奈米深度解析與 ppb 靈敏度。~Depth resolution is bounded by three effects: ion mixing that pushes atoms deeper, to about twice the projected range of the primary ions; sputter-induced surface roughening; and the sloping crater walls that keep contributing shallow signal not yet profiled. Low energy (250 eV to 1 keV) and oblique incidence reduce mixing, sample rotation suppresses roughening, and electronic gating accepts secondary ions only from a central fraction of the raster to exclude the walls. Insulators charge positively under positive-ion bombardment, shifting secondary-ion energies and killing the signal, so a low-energy electron gun neutralises them; negative primary ions (O⁻) or pulsed electron flooding in TOF instruments are common alternatives. Integrating these mechanisms with chamber vacuum and stage precision is what delivers nanometre depth resolution together with ppb sensitivity.
units.model: 1 keV O₂⁺ 在矽中的投影射程約 3 nm，離子混合深度約 6 nm，剖析硼 δ 層時下降邊的衰減長度約 2 nm/decade，訊號要下降 3 個數量級需約 6 nm；把能量降到 250 eV，衰減長度縮到約 1 nm/decade，δ 層寬度減半。電子閘控：200 µm 的掃描區只接受中央 30% 面積，分析區邊長 200×√0.30 ≈ 110 µm，坑壁影響被排除在閘外。殘氣背景：10⁻¹⁰ mbar 下分子到達率約 3×10¹⁰ cm⁻²s⁻¹，濺射去除率 0.3 nm/s 相當於 1×10¹⁵ atoms·cm⁻²s⁻¹，比值 3×10⁻⁵，即吸附背景相當於 30 ppm 的上限，必須靠高濺射速率或更好的真空壓低。~For 1 keV O₂⁺ in silicon the projected range is about 3 nm and the mixing depth about 6 nm; profiling a boron δ-layer gives a trailing-edge decay length near 2 nm/decade, so three decades of fall need about 6 nm, while 250 eV shortens the decay to about 1 nm/decade and halves the δ-layer width. Electronic gating: accepting only the central 30% of a 200 µm raster gives an analysed square of side 200×√0.30 ≈ 110 µm, keeping crater walls outside the gate. Residual-gas background: at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar molecules arrive at about 3×10¹⁰ cm⁻²s⁻¹ while sputtering at 0.3 nm/s removes about 1×10¹⁵ atoms·cm⁻²s⁻¹, a ratio of 3×10⁻⁵, so adsorbed background sets a ceiling near 30 ppm that only faster sputtering or better vacuum lowers.
units.verify: 用含多層硼 δ 層的矽參考樣品剖析，量每層的上升與下降衰減長度（nm/decade）與半高寬，在 1 keV 與 250 eV 各做一次比較；以不同閘控比例（10%、30%、50%）重複剖析，確認下降邊不隨閘控縮小而改善後即為坑壁效應已排除；絕緣樣品（熱氧化矽 100 nm）剖析時監控二次離子能量分佈的峰位，調整電子槍直到峰位穩定在 ±2 V 內。~Profile a silicon reference containing multiple boron δ-layers, measuring each layer's rising and trailing decay lengths (nm/decade) and width at 1 keV and again at 250 eV; repeat with gate fractions of 10%, 30% and 50% and treat the point where the trailing edge no longer improves as proof that crater-wall effects are excluded; on an insulating sample (100 nm thermal oxide) monitor the secondary-ion energy distribution peak and tune the electron gun until the peak holds within ±2 V.
units.failure: 沒有閘控或閘控太寬時，坑壁讓每個界面的下降邊拖出數十奈米的尾巴，1 nm 的 δ 層看起來像 20 nm 的擴散層；絕緣樣品中和不足時，二次離子能量帶偏移出能量狹縫，訊號在界面附近「消失」又「出現」，被誤認為真實的濃度變化。~Without gating or with too wide a gate, crater walls drag each interface's trailing edge into tails of tens of nanometres, so a 1 nm δ-layer looks like a 20 nm diffused layer; an under-neutralised insulator shifts the secondary-ion energy band out of the energy slit, and the signal vanishing and reappearing near interfaces is mistaken for real concentration changes.
units.misconception: 深度解析度只由一次束的束徑決定，與能量、入射角無關。~Depth resolution is set only by the primary-beam diameter, not by energy or incidence angle.

units.anchor: 參考樣品組與配方紀錄~Reference-sample set and recipe records
units.title: 儀器驗收、配方控制與工程交接~Instrument acceptance, recipe control and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: SIMS 的性能完全綁定在分析配方上：一次離子種類、能量、入射角、束流、掃描尺寸、閘控比例、質量解析度、氧氣吹掃與中和條件任一改變，RSF、偵測極限與深度解析度都隨之改變。驗收因此以配方為單位：每個配方用植入標準片驗證 RSF 的重現性、用 δ 層樣品驗證深度解析度、用高純矽驗證偵測極限、用質量雙峰驗證解析度、用絕緣樣品驗證中和。交接文件把每個配方的參數、對應標準片、驗收結果與趨勢圖綁在一起，任何人換配方時必須重走驗收流程。~SIMS performance is bound to the analytical recipe: changing the primary species, energy, incidence angle, current, raster size, gate fraction, mass resolution, oxygen flooding or neutralisation changes the RSF, detection limit and depth resolution. Acceptance is therefore organised per recipe: each recipe verifies RSF reproducibility on an implant standard, depth resolution on a δ-layer sample, detection limits on high-purity silicon, resolution on a mass doublet and neutralisation on an insulator. The handoff binds every recipe's parameters, its matching standards, acceptance results and trend charts together, and anyone who changes a recipe must repeat the acceptance sequence.
units.model: 矽中硼 1 keV O₂⁺ 配方的驗收門檻範例：RSF 五次重複相對標準差 ≤ 10%，與上次驗收的 RSF 偏差 ≤ 15%；δ 層下降衰減長度 ≤ 2.5 nm/decade；硼偵測極限 ≤ 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻³（1 s 停留）；m/z 31 的 ³¹P⁺/³⁰SiH⁺ 在 m/Δm = 4 000 下達 10% 谷值；100 nm 熱氧化層剖析中 Si⁺ 強度波動 ≤ 10%；坑深 600 nm 的量測重現性 ≤ 10 nm。若 RSF 漂移超過 15%，先檢查一次束流與氧氣吹掃壓力，再檢查倍增器增益。~Example acceptance thresholds for a boron-in-silicon 1 keV O₂⁺ recipe: RSF relative standard deviation ≤ 10% over five repeats and within 15% of the previous acceptance; δ-layer trailing decay length ≤ 2.5 nm/decade; boron detection limit ≤ 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻³ at 1 s dwell; ³¹P⁺/³⁰SiH⁺ at m/z 31 separated to a 10% valley at m/Δm = 4 000; Si⁺ intensity fluctuation ≤ 10% through a 100 nm thermal-oxide profile; crater-depth repeatability ≤ 10 nm at 600 nm. An RSF drift beyond 15% triggers a check of primary current and oxygen-flood pressure before the multiplier gain.
units.verify: 依配方逐項執行上述測試並填入驗收表，每項附原始剖析檔、坑深輪廓與束流紀錄；把 RSF、偵測極限與束流的趨勢圖隨驗收表更新；交接時由接手工程師在同一標準片上獨立重做 RSF 與 δ 層測試，兩人結果差異 ≤ 10% 才完成交接。~Execute the tests recipe by recipe, enter them into the acceptance table and attach the raw profiles, crater profilometry and beam-current logs for each; update the RSF, detection-limit and beam-current trend charts with every acceptance; at handoff the incoming engineer independently repeats the RSF and δ-layer tests on the same standards, and the handoff completes only when the two results agree within 10%.
units.failure: 為了提高通量把一次束流加倍卻沿用舊 RSF，所有濃度報告偏差數十個百分點而無人察覺；交接時缺少標準片的來源與剩餘可用面積，新工程師在已被剖析過的區域重量，RSF 與偵測極限兩項同時失真。~Doubling the primary current for throughput while keeping the old RSF biases every reported concentration by tens of percent unnoticed; a handoff lacking the standards' provenance and remaining usable area leads the new engineer to re-measure already-profiled regions, corrupting both the RSF and the detection limit.
units.misconception: 儀器通過一次驗收後，任何配方的數據都可直接定量。~Once the instrument passes acceptance, data from any recipe can be quantified directly.

example: RSF 與偵測極限練習：硼植入矽標準片劑量 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻²，以 1 keV O₂⁺、0.5 nm/s 剖析到 600 nm，積分得 Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm，RSF = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³。未知晶圓同配方量得 I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴，濃度 = 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³（約 10 ppm）。該配方下 1 ppm 硼給 56 cps，此樣品約 560 cps；背景 0.5 cps、停留 1 s，偵測極限 = 3√0.5/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³，即此樣品的訊號高於偵測極限約 260 倍。若坑深量測誤差 ±10 nm，深度尺度誤差 ±1.7%，RSF 因積分深度步長同步改變而誤差 ±1.7%；若一次束流漂移 −20% 而未重量 RSF，矩陣離子與痕量離子同步下降，比值不變，濃度仍正確，但濺射速率下降 20%，深度尺度若沿用舊值會偏深 25%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~RSF and detection-limit exercise: a boron-implanted silicon standard with dose 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² is profiled with 1 keV O₂⁺ at 0.5 nm/s to 600 nm, and the integral Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm gives RSF = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³. An unknown wafer under the same recipe shows I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴, a concentration of 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³ (about 10 ppm). Since 1 ppm of boron gives 56 cps in this recipe, the sample yields about 560 cps; with 0.5 cps background and 1 s dwell the detection limit is 3√0.5/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³, so the signal sits about 260 times above it. A ±10 nm crater-depth error gives ±1.7% on the depth scale and the same ±1.7% on the RSF through the depth step; a −20% primary-current drift without re-measuring the RSF leaves the trace-to-matrix ratio and the concentration correct, but the sputter rate falls 20% and a depth scale carried over from the old rate reads 25% too deep. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1949 年 Herzog 與 Viehböck 在維也納首次以質譜分析濺射出的二次離子；1960 年代 Castaing 與 Slodzian 在奧賽建立離子顯微鏡，1968 年由 CAMECA 商品化為 IMS 300，Liebl 則發展出離子微探針；1969 年 Benninghoven 在明斯特提出靜態 SIMS，1980 年代結合飛行時間分析器，1989 年 ION-TOF 成立。1990 年代後半導體摻雜剖析成為動態 SIMS 的主要應用，CAMECA 的 NanoSIMS 把橫向解析度推進到 50 nm，團簇離子源則打開有機與生物樣品的分析。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~In 1949 Herzog and Viehböck in Vienna first analysed sputtered secondary ions by mass spectrometry; in the 1960s Castaing and Slodzian at Orsay built the ion microscope, commercialised by CAMECA as the IMS 300 in 1968, while Liebl developed the ion microprobe; in 1969 Benninghoven at Münster introduced static SIMS, combined it with time-of-flight analysers in the 1980s, and ION-TOF was founded in 1989. From the 1990s semiconductor dopant profiling became the main application of dynamic SIMS, the CAMECA NanoSIMS pushed lateral resolution to 50 nm, and cluster ion sources opened organic and biological analysis. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
